Teleon.dev · purpose-driven runtime

Teleon turns functions, jobs, workers, and automations into self-adaptive capabilities.

Category: intent-native, eval-gated, self-adaptive compute

Cloud work is provisioned by implementation type (functions, jobs, workers), not by purpose — so it can't evaluate a better/cheaper implementation or move runtimes safely on evidence.

Define your first CapabilityTask See the runtime adapters

Preview build — temporary URL, not production hosting.

What it is & what it owns

What it is

  • Intent-native, eval-gated, self-adaptive compute.
  • A purpose-defined runtime built around the CapabilityTask / PurposeTask object.

What it owns

  • CapabilityTask / PurposeTask runtime
  • Runtime selection
  • Implementation candidates
  • Evidence ledger
  • Promotion + policy gates
  • Boundary approvals

What it is not & what it does not own

What it is not

  • Not a generic AI-agent deployment product.
  • Not a replacement for Kubernetes.
  • Not a replacement for cloud functions.
  • Not unbounded self-modifying code.

What it does not own

  • Governed context truth (that is Baltor)
  • The open skill registry (that is OpenHubForAI)

Who it is for

Platform-engineering, AI-infrastructure, DevOps/SRE, and automation teams.

Use case: Declare a CapabilityTask once; Teleon selects the runtime, tests candidate implementations side-by-side, and promotes only with evidence.

Core design

CapabilityTask stays stable. Implementation evolves. Runtime changes. Evidence decides. Policy gates promotion. Humans approve boundary expansion.

Runtime adapters

local function · managed venv · local job · local worker pool · cloud function · Kubernetes job · queue worker · browser worker · GPU worker.

Dashboards

Teleon Control Tower for staff; the Capability Assurance Portal for customers — one truth model, two governed views (the dashboard never owns truth).

Quickstart & docs

Engineer path: the CapabilityTask contract and the service-connection handshake are documented API-first (SERVICE-CONNECTIONS.md, agent-gateway MCP projection); quickstart = declare one CapabilityTask against the local runtime, read the receipt. Docs ship with the platform handoff.

How it fits the portfolio

purpose → contract → runtime selection → candidate → evidence → eval-gated promotion / rollback

Teleon runs and evolves capabilities. Baltor consumes Teleon through the PurposeTaskProviderPort; Teleon returns evidence/candidate/result, never Baltor truth. Teleon consumes templates, skills, and eval packs from OpenHubForAI.
